# SalesAI Create for HVAC Companies

> SalesAI Create helps established HVAC companies become easier to find and trust in the service areas they want to serve, without adding more marketing management to the owner's workload.

## Primary promise

More Google Business Profile visibility in 90 days, or we keep working at no additional service fee until you get it.

If your Google Business Profile views do not increase during your first 90 days with Create, we will continue the visibility work included in your plan at no additional service fee until they do. Eligibility requirements, customer responsibilities, and exclusions apply.

The 90-day guarantee period begins on the date we receive usable access to your verified Google Business Profile.

No contracts. No hidden fees.

This is a continued-work guarantee, not a money-back guarantee. It applies only to Google Business Profile views and does not promise a specific position or any increase in leads, calls, sales, revenue, or another business result.

## Owner benefits

- Be easier to find when local homeowners need HVAC help.
- Build reviews that give homeowners more reason to choose the company.
- Reach homeowners looking for the service and replacement work the company provides.
- Know what is being done, why it matters, and what comes next.
- Build a local presence that is not dependent on shared leads.
- Get marketing support without having to manage it internally.

## Four-stage HVAC visibility plan

1. Get Found Locally: Improve the business information homeowners use to understand services, service areas, credibility, and contact options.
2. Build Trust Before the Call: Support local trust through review requests, review responses, and local-search work focused on priority HVAC services and communities.
3. Build Trust and Track Inquiries: Make useful service information easier to find and provide clearer visibility into the marketing sources behind phone inquiries.
4. Expand What Works: Add paid advertising and automation around the services, areas, capacity, and priorities that matter most to the company.

## First 90 days

- Days 1 to 30: Make it easier to be found and trusted locally by improving visible business information, local listing consistency, the review-request process, and monthly accountability.
- Days 31 to 60: Focus visibility on the HVAC work and service areas the company wants more of.
- Days 61 to 90: Make it easier for ready-to-hire homeowners to contact the company and review completed work, available visibility data, and next priorities.

These descriptions state work performed, not promised business outcomes.

## Customer fit

Create is for established HVAC companies that want help getting found and chosen locally, clearer accountability for their marketing investment, support aligned with priority services and service areas, and more time to run the business without building an in-house marketing department.
